operations_plan.summary: Create a reflected copy of the complete existing solid about the plane coincident with the flat, non-rounded terminal end face of the lever arm.

steps.description: Identify the planar terminal face at the square, non-rounded +X end of the long arm. Use arm end face 7, located at x=80 and normal to the X axis, as the mirror plane. This resolves the requested plane lying on the non-rounded end without requiring a separate datum plane.

Select the complete original solid body rather than individual faces or features. The mirror source must include the longitudinal arm, rounded -X terminal, blended pedestal, outer cylindrical boss, and blind cylindrical bore so that all exterior and interior geometry is reproduced.

Mirror the selected complete solid across the plane coincident with face 7. The reflected body must extend from x=80 toward +X, while the original remains unchanged. Preserve the arm cross-section and alignment; reproduce the rounded terminal, pedestal, hollow boss, blind-bore diameter and depth, and boss axis orientation. The original and reflected solids must have coincident terminal interfaces at the mirror plane.

operations_plan.summary: Boolean-union the mirrored solid with the preserved original solid to produce one continuous double-ended body.

steps.description: Confirm that the original and mirrored arm bodies meet over the complete rectangular area of the former terminal face 7 at x=80. The corresponding arm top, bottom, front, and back boundaries must remain collinear across this interface, with no gap, offset, or angular mismatch.

Apply a Boolean union with the original solid as the target and the mirrored solid from operation_01_step_03 as the tool. Merge across the coincident end-face interface and remove the internal duplicate face so the result is one contiguous solid body rather than two touching bodies.

Refine the fused B-rep to remove the obsolete coplanar seam at the mirror plane. Validate that exactly one solid remains; the long arm is continuous and uniform through x=80; both outer ends are rounded; and two reflected boss assemblies remain intact with their coaxial blind cylindrical bores and planar bore floors. Do not add fillets, chamfers, or other geometry not present in the source body.
